parsed.post: Significant improvement in val_bpb (1.107 -> 1.046). The increase in learning rate/adjustment seems to have paid off. Moving on to optimize the architecture constants, specifically testing a higher ASPECT_RATIO to improve context modeling efficiency.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if a wider context window improves compression efficiency within the same 5-minute budget.
